settings.key_insight: Rawhide isn't just low-quality — it's processed with chemicals that have no business being in your dog's mouth. The switch to yak chews isn't a trend. It's the obvious choice once you know what rawhide actually is.
settings.article_body:
When I moved to the US, I was shocked by how normalized rawhide was. Walk into any pet store and it's everywhere — cheap, abundant, and marketed as a "natural" chew. It's not natural. Not even close.

What rawhide actually is

Rawhide is the inner layer of cow or horse hide. To make it shelf-stable and white, manufacturers treat it with sodium sulphide liming, bleach, and hydrogen peroxide. Some imported rawhide has tested positive for arsenic, lead, and formaldehyde residue.

That's what your dog is chewing on.

The real risks

Beyond the chemical processing, rawhide has two mechanical problems:

  • Swallowing chunks. Rawhide softens as dogs chew it, and large pieces can break off and be swallowed whole. These don't digest — they can cause intestinal blockages that require emergency surgery.
  • Contamination. The FDA has issued multiple warnings about Salmonella contamination in rawhide products.

Why yak chews are different

Himalayan yak chews are made from yak milk and cow milk, hardened through a traditional process that's been used in Nepal for centuries. The ingredients are: yak milk, cow milk, salt, lime juice. No processing chemicals. No bleach. No mystery.

They're also fully digestible. When your dog chews off a piece, it breaks down in the stomach. The nub at the end can be microwaved into a puffed treat — nothing goes to waste.

The honest comparison

I'm not going to tell you yak chews are perfect for every dog. If your dog has a dairy sensitivity, they're not the right choice. If your dog is a power-chewer who finishes a Large in under 20 minutes, you need to supervise closely and size up.

But compared to rawhide? It's not close. Yak chews are safer, cleaner, and more digestible — and they last longer for most dogs.

That's why I built Prime around them.
